title: Ingestion pipeline layers: framework, common, concrete pipelines
answers: Where is the analytics ingestion pipeline composed?
How do I write a pipeline step?
body:
Framework `nodejs/src/ingestion/framework/`:
- `steps.ts:ProcessingStep` = value => Promise<PipelineResult>; built by factories like `createDenyEventsStep`.
- `results.ts`: PipelineResult = OK|DLQ|DROP|REDIRECT (`ok/dlq/drop/redirect`), each with `sideEffects: Promise[]` and `warnings`.
- `pipeline.interface.ts:PipelineContext`; builders in `builders/pipeline-builders.ts` and `builders/chunk-pipeline-builders.ts` (`newPipelineBuilder`, `newChunkPipelineBuilder`): `.pipe/.pipeChunk/.sequentially/.concurrentlyPerGroup/.compose`, end with `.handleResults()/.handleSideEffects()/.build()`.
- Docs-as-tests: `framework/docs/01-…17-*.test.ts`.
Shared `src/ingestion/common/`: `common-ingestion-pipeline.ts:newCommonIngestionPipeline` (beforeBatch, per-event steps, afterBatch); `ingestion-consumer.ts:CommonIngestionConsumer`; `steps/`, `subpipelines/`.
Concrete `src/ingestion/pipelines/{analytics,ai,clientwarnings,errortracking,heatmaps,metrics,sessionreplay}`.
Analytics: `pipelines/analytics/joined-ingestion-pipeline.ts:createJoinedIngestionPipeline` → per-chunk rate limit/prefetch → parseMessage/resolveTeam → `createPostTeamPreprocessingSubpipeline` → `concurrentlyPerGroup(getTokenAndDistinctId)` → `sequentially(createEventSubpipeline)` (event-subpipeline.ts) → `createCreateEventStep`. Consumer: `src/ingestion/ingestion-consumer.ts:IngestionConsumer`.

search: Ingestion pipeline architecture spans three layers: framework defines ProcessingStep (value => Promise<PipelineResult>) with results (OK/DLQ/DROP/REDIRECT, each with sideEffects and warnings) in `nodejs/src/ingestion/framework/{steps,results,pipeline.interface}.ts`; builders like `newPipelineBuilder`, `newChunkPipelineBuilder` provide `.pipe/.pipeChunk/.sequentially/.concurrentlyPerGroup/.compose`, ending with `.handleResults()/.handleSideEffects()/.build()`. Common layer in `src/ingestion/common/` provides `newCommonIngestionPipeline` (beforeBatch, per-event, afterBatch) and `CommonIngestionConsumer`. Concrete pipelines in `src/ingestion/pipelines/{analytics,ai,clientwarnings,errortracking,heatmaps,metrics,sessionreplay}`; analytics pipeline `joined-ingestion-pipeline.ts:createJoinedIngestionPipeline` chains rate limit/prefetch → parseMessage/resolveTeam → preprocessing → `concurrentlyPerGroup(getTokenAndDistinctId)` → event subpipeline.
